title: US-short §11.4 exclusion_summary governance — const-pins the exclusion category set, the two-pass coverage, the privacy split, and the hot_excluded audit (never rescues hard-veto / never changes admission)
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §11.4 weekly exclusion summary: the exclusion category set (流动性/价格市值/停牌退市破产/增发SEC/数据unknown/事件unknown/数据源失败/分不够), coverage of BOTH Pass-1 eligibility drops and Pass-2 audit-gate drops, the privacy split (real-holding exclusions → private path; pure public-universe counts → trackable), and the hot_excluded audit (tickers with theme_heat_score at percentile yet dropped at a safety/liquidity/data gate — surfaced ONLY to find mistaken kills; it NEVER rescues a hard veto and NEVER changes admission; holding rows private; feeds §13 review of theme weights / safety-gate thresholds). The hot_excluded percentile threshold is forward-calibrated (not pinned). draft-07 cannot express: category byte-faithfulness, provenance in §11.4, and exclusion_summary presence in the weekly_report section set — enforced in tests.
